content.text: Inventory of call sites is ready in the SDK retry audit spreadsheet; three modules still need migration.
Several SDK modules still retry network failures with fixed Thread.sleep loops that ignore jitter and total deadline budgets.
Replace those ad-hoc sleeps with the shared exponential backoff package already used by the CLI so retry policy stays consistent across languages.
Preserve existing public retry hook callbacks and add a unit test that proves backoff doubles up to the configured ceiling.
